snippet.title: FINAL WITNESS Official Trailer - PSX Horror game
snippet.description:
FINAL WITNESS Official trailer - Available Today on ITCH.IO
Created by Hexnut Studios

Based on a 911 CALL.

FINAL WITNESS is a PSX-style cinematic horror experience about uncovering a truth that was never meant to be found.

Playtime: 1 hour.
